sourceChecks.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of the LORD’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。
